text.arabic_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَن نَّدْخُلَهَآ أَبَدًۭا مَّا دَامُوا۟ فِيهَا ۖ فَٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَرَبُّكَ فَقَٰتِلَآ إِنَّا هَٰهُنَا قَٰعِدُونَ

words.gloss_range: completed collective speech introducing a quoted refusal and counter-command
words.root_gloss_range: saying, speaking, reporting, and voiced utterance; locally the perfect plural reports a completed collective answer
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) makes the refusal arrive first as a completed collective utterance. The plural verb compresses the speakers into one voice, and that voice governs the whole quoted sequence: non-entry, delegated going and fighting, then sitting. The repeated address formula from the previous scene (5:22) keeps the confrontation with Moses continuous while shifting authority from the two counselors to the crowd.

topics.headline: collective quoted refusal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah opens with a completed collective speech act that performs the refusal before any individual argument is heard.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify a perfect plural speech verb governing the whole quotation, while the CRITICAL rows coherently press collective speech, refusal-performance, and boundary echo.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle opening direct address
words.prose: {{ar:يَٰ}} ({{tr:yā}}) turns the report into direct confrontation. Before the refusal itself is stated, the particle summons Moses as the addressed party, so the coming words are not neutral narration but an answer aimed at him. Its reprise of the prior address frame (5:22) makes the second refusal sound like an intensified return to the same face-to-face scene.

topics.headline: direct vocative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the refusal as direct address to Moses, not as a detached report about him.
topics.reason: The local parse forces a vocative relation to Moses, and the CRITICAL rows add the confrontational and repeated-address payoff without contradiction.

words.gloss_range: foreign prophetic proper name as direct vocative addressee
words.prose: {{ar:مُوسَىٰٓ}} ({{tr:mūsā}}) completes the address by naming the prophetic addressee before the refusal unfolds. The proper name concentrates the entry and combat scene around Moses: the people refuse their own entry, then redirect motion and fighting toward the one they have named. The recurrence of Moses with entry and combat language in nearby scenes (5:22; 5:24; 5:25) makes the name a hinge for the confrontation.

topics.headline: named prophetic addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the people's refusal and delegated command being aimed at Moses by name, concentrating responsibility onto him.
topics.reason: The word is parsed as a foreign proper noun in vocative address, and the CRITICAL rows coherently connect that address with the entry and combat scene.

words.gloss_range: emphatic first-person plural assertion opening the refusal clause
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) begins the refusal as an emphatic collective self-statement. The particle gives the speakers a formal subject-position before the negated entry verb, so their first claim is not merely that entry will not happen but that they, as a group, assert it. Because the ayah closes with another {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}), the refusal and the sitting declaration become matching bookends.

topics.headline: emphatic collective opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people first assert themselves as a collective before stating what they refuse to do.
topics.reason: The local inna clause governs the negated refusal predicate, and the repeated particle at the close supports the CRITICAL ring-frame payoff.

words.gloss_range: emphatic future negation governing the entry verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَن}} ({{tr:lan}}) turns entry into an emphatically refused future. It governs the following verb's subjunctive mood, so the people's stance is built into the grammar before the object land is reached. Against the earlier command to enter (5:21) and the earlier refusal formula (5:22), this particle hardens the answer into explicit non-entry.

topics.headline: emphatic future non-entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the refusal become grammaticalized as future non-entry before the verb itself is complete.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as subjunctive future negation governing the entry verb, which directly supports the CRITICAL polarity and boundary claims.

words.gloss_range: first-person plural negated self-entry into the referenced land
words.root_gloss_range: entering, going inside, and crossing a threshold; locally the root is selected as refused entry into the land, not causation or insertion
words.prose: {{ar:نَّدْخُلَهَآ}} ({{tr:nadkhulahā}}) names the action the speakers withhold from themselves: entering the land. The first-person plural makes them the missing agents of obedience, while the attached object suffix keeps the land inside the verb rather than in a separate phrase. The root's threshold pressure survives, but the local Form I and negation narrow it to refused self-entry, reversing the command to enter across the boundary (5:21-22).

topics.headline: negated threshold entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people refuse their own threshold-crossing into the land, with the object land fused into the verb.
topics.reason: The local parse supports first-person plural Form I entry with an attached object under negation; broader causative or root-expansion claims are kept only as threshold pressure.

words.gloss_range: accusative time adverb intensifying the refusal as unending
words.root_gloss_range: perpetuity, endless duration, and remote untamed extension; locally the adverb supplies unlimited time to the negated entry
words.prose: {{ar:أَبَدًۭا}} ({{tr:abadan}}) adds the time-word that was absent from the earlier refusal (5:22). It does not merely repeat non-entry; it stretches the refusal into unbounded duration. The accusative adverbial form and final tanwīn make the first refusal beat close on permanence, while any wilder root pressure remains subordinate to the local sense of endless time.

topics.headline: unbounded refusal time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refusal intensified from non-entry into non-entry without an endpoint.
topics.reason: The local grammar makes the word an accusative temporal adverb modifying the negated entry; broader root-color claims are limited to pressure around endless duration.

words.gloss_range: temporal/source particle introducing the duration clause
words.prose: {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) keeps the refusal attached to a duration condition rather than opening a second negation. It begins the clause that measures the refusal by the opponents' continued presence, turning the earlier condition into a sustained time frame. The particle's value is therefore narrowed by its construction with the following persistence verb.

topics.headline: temporal duration link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refusal is time-bounded by enemy presence, not followed by an independent negation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following phrase as a temporal clause limiting the negated entering, so the CRITICAL ambiguity is preserved only as construction-bound temporal force.

words.gloss_range: third-person plural persistence inside the temporal condition
words.root_gloss_range: continuing, lasting, persisting, and enduring; locally it marks the opponents' continued presence as the duration of refusal
words.prose: {{ar:دَامُوا۟}} ({{tr:dāmū}}) makes the opponents' presence the clock of the refusal. The verb is plural and intransitive here: the blockers are recoverable from context, and their remaining inside the land becomes the semantic barrier. Its rare duration language can echo larger permanence contexts, but the local clause keeps the force on continued occupation, not cosmic duration as the selected sense.

topics.headline: persistent presence barrier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that enemy presence is not a background fact; it becomes the duration-measure that sustains the people's refusal.
topics.reason: The temporal clause and local intransitive plural form support persistence as a barrier; wider duration echoes are kept as contextual pressure rather than controlling the parse.

words.gloss_range: locative prepositional phrase with feminine land-pronoun
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) closes the temporal condition by locating the blockers inside the land. The same feminine pronoun keeps the land present across the refusal: it is the object they will not enter and the container in which the opponents remain. The locative phrase therefore makes inside-space itself the reason the speakers present for staying out.

topics.headline: contested inside-space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the land as a shared referent that is both refused as object and occupied as inside-space.
topics.reason: The local preposition and pronoun form a forced locative complement, and the CRITICAL rows coherently track the land-pronoun chain.

words.gloss_range: consequential connector pivoting from refusal to imperative delegation
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) turns the completed refusal into a counter-command. After the people declare non-entry, this connector pivots immediately to delegated motion: their refusal becomes the reason they tell Moses to go. The small particle is therefore the hinge between a negated act they reject and an imperative they assign elsewhere.

topics.headline: refusal-to-delegation pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command to Moses is framed as the consequence of the group's refusal.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the connector as introducing the imperative after the refusal, matching the CRITICAL delegation-pivot rows.

words.gloss_range: second-person singular imperative of directed departure, with destination left implicit
words.root_gloss_range: going, departing, passing away, and vanishing; locally the command selects directed movement while loss/vanishing remains only image-pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱذْهَبْ}} ({{tr:idh'hab}}) isolates Moses as the one commanded to move. The second-person singular imperative excludes the speaking group, and the lack of an explicit destination lets the next command collapse the route into combat. The departure root can carry loss or vanishing pressure, but the local imperative selects go-away motion, not a separate gold or disappearance sense.

topics.headline: delegated singular departure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that movement is transferred away from the group and placed on Moses alone before the Lord is added.
topics.reason: The local Form I second-person singular imperative supports directed departure and role-transfer; broader root polysemy is limited to image-pressure.

words.gloss_range: explicit second-person singular pronoun reinforcing the imperative subject
words.prose: {{ar:أَنتَ}} ({{tr:anta}}) makes the imperative subject explicit even though the verb already contains it. That extra pronoun foregrounds Moses against the speaking group and creates a buffer before the Lord is coordinated with him. The burden is therefore marked as yours, not ours, before the sentence expands the commanded pair.

topics.headline: explicit you-burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Moses singled out by an explicit pronoun that the imperative did not grammatically require.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence reads the pronoun as explicit subject reinforcement, supporting the CRITICAL isolation and burden-transfer rows.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining Moses and his Lord as the pair picked up by the dual imperative
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is small, but it creates the pair that the next dual imperative will address. The particle can carry coordination or accompaniment pressure, yet the following dual command narrows the local effect: Moses and his Lord are treated as the two commanded agents, while the speakers remain outside the action.

topics.headline: coordination into dual command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees how one conjunction turns Moses from isolated addressee into one member of the dual command pair.
topics.reason: The local conjoined relation is strongly licensed, and the following dual imperative resolves the conjunction's payoff into a two-agent command frame.

words.gloss_range: construct Lord-title with second-person masculine singular suffix, conjoined into the delegated action pair
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, nurturing, sustaining, and governing; locally the title is possessively linked to Moses and pressed into the speakers' combat delegation
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكَ}} ({{tr:rabbuka}}) names the Lord through Moses's suffix, not through a shared communal claim. The construct title carries lordship and sustaining-care pressure, but the local wording narrows that pressure into a distancing relation: your Lord is placed with you in the delegated pair. The next ayah's response changes the relation into direct supplicatory address (5:25), answering the pressure without accepting the people's role assignment.

topics.headline: Moses-bound lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the distancing force of your Lord: divine lordship is invoked through Moses and conscripted into the role the speakers avoid.
topics.reason: The noun is construct with a second-person suffix and conjoined to the explicit pronoun; root-lordship pressure is valid but must be worded through that local possessive relation.

words.gloss_range: sequential connector chaining the go-command into the fight-command
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the second imperative feel immediate: go, then fight. Its repetition after the earlier connector gives the delegation a rapid rhythm, carrying the sentence from refusal to motion to combat. The particle does not add a new actor; it tightens the sequence that assigns action away from the speakers.

topics.headline: motion-to-combat chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the second command as the immediate continuation of the first, not as a detached instruction.
topics.reason: The connector introduces the second imperative in sequence after the first, matching the CRITICAL rows about rapid delegation rhythm.

words.gloss_range: dual Form III imperative assigning reciprocal combat to two addressed agents
words.root_gloss_range: killing, fighting, lethal struggle, and combat; locally Form III and dual marking select mutual combat rather than bare one-sided killing
words.prose: {{ar:قَٰتِلَآ}} ({{tr:qātilā}}) is the command where the delegated action becomes combat. The dual ending locks the command onto Moses and his Lord while excluding the plural speakers, and Form III makes the action reciprocal fighting rather than a bare killing act. Because the object is omitted, attention stays on the two assigned fighters; the same root then reverberates into the nearby killing narrative (5:27-30) and back to the earlier command around Moses (2:54).

topics.headline: dual delegated combat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that lethal reciprocal engagement is assigned to exactly two agents while the speaking group removes itself from the combat role.
topics.reason: The QAC form is a dual Form III imperative, and local coordination supplies the two addressed agents; object omission supports role-transfer rather than enemy focus.

topics.headline: combat echo field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears this fight-command as part of a Moses-linked root field that looks ahead to killing in the same surah and back to earlier commanded killing.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete echoes, and none controls the local parse; they survive as intertextual pressure tied to the same root.

words.gloss_range: repeated emphatic first-person plural assertion opening the final self-description
words.prose: The second {{ar:إِنَّا}} ({{tr:innā}}) brings the ayah back to the speakers after the delegated imperatives. The same emphatic collective form that opened refusal now opens their self-description as sitters, so the middle command chain is enclosed by their own asserted identity. What began as we will not enter ends as we are sitting here.

topics.headline: closing collective bookend
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final self-assertion closing the ring between refusal and sitting.
topics.reason: The second inna clause governs the final declaration, and the repeated first-person particle supports the CRITICAL bookend and performative-refusal rows.

words.gloss_range: attention particle fused to the following here-adverb
words.prose: {{ar:هَٰ}} ({{tr:hā}}) is the attention particle that makes the final location pointed. It does not carry an independent place meaning; it fastens itself to the following here-word so the closure begins with an emphatic gesture toward this place before the sitting predicate is named. The repeated h-sound helps attention and location arrive as one deictic phrase.

topics.headline: pointed here-attention
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the final location as pointed and presentative before the sitting state appears.
topics.reason: QAC identifies an attention particle before the place adverb, and local attachment places the resulting location phrase before the predicate.

words.gloss_range: proximate place adverb anchoring the final sitting predicate
words.prose: {{ar:هُنَا}} ({{tr:hunā}}) fixes the speakers in the present location before their posture is named. After commands that send Moses outward, here pulls the scene back to the group's chosen place and makes location central to the closing self-description. Claims that import humiliation from a separate root are blocked locally: QAC treats this word as an indeclinable place adverb with no lexical root.

topics.headline: fixed here against motion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final self-location as the opposite of the outward motion assigned to Moses.
topics.reason: The local word is an adverb of place preceding the sitting predicate, and the boundary evidence supports the contrast between threshold movement and fixed here.

topics.headline: unsupported humiliation root pressure
topics.blocking_evidence: QAC aligns {{ar:هُنَا}} ({{tr:hunā}}) as an indeclinable place adverb with no lexical root, so a separate humiliation-root field cannot govern the local parse.
topics.reason: The local evidence supports proximate deixis and spatial anchoring; it does not license treating the word as a h-w-n root occurrence.

words.gloss_range: nominative masculine plural active participle naming the speakers as continuing sitters
words.root_gloss_range: sitting, remaining, holding back, abstaining, and foundation-like settledness; locally the participle makes nonparticipation a collective state
words.prose: {{ar:قَٰعِدُونَ}} ({{tr:qāʿidūn}}) lands the ayah on a nominal identity, not a one-time sitting event. As the predicate of the final emphatic clause, the active participle names the speakers as continuing sitters while combat is assigned elsewhere. The root's sitting and holding-back range makes physical posture and abstention converge; echoes with sitters versus strivers (4:95), saying-and-sitting back around killing (3:168), and the previous prevailing participle (5:23) sharpen the closing reversal.

topics.headline: collective sitting identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the speakers end by defining themselves as continuing sitters, not merely by reporting that they sat down.
topics.reason: The local noun active participle is the nominative predicate of the final clause, supporting collective state-identity and noncombat role.

topics.headline: sitting echo and reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final sitting state as a reversal of nearby prevailing language and as part of a broader refusal-to-fight pattern.
topics.reason: The concrete cross-references are useful as echo and contrast, but they do not replace the local active-participle predicate as the governing parse.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The refusal to enter, its unlimited time phrase, the occupants' continued presence, and the speakers' sitting here form one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The absolute future refusal is reinforced by two duration roots and closed by a deictic sitting-position. The occupants' continued presence becomes the clock that keeps the speakers fixed outside.

activation_trace.role: Crossing into an interior supplies the threshold that the speakers categorically block.
Unbounded duration hardens a present objection into an unlimited refusal.
Continuity and stability make the occupants' presence the sustaining condition of non-entry.
Fixed sitting gives the temporal refusal a declared spatial endpoint here.

changed_reading.before: The group says it will not enter while the occupants remain.
changed_reading.after: The group constructs a self-renewing spatial-temporal lock: their staying there licenses our staying here without end.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Go, you and your Lord, then fight, is set against the collective declaration that we are sitting here.
baseline_models.mechanism: A singular command of motion expands to a dual command of combat, while the first-person plural reserves only immobility. The utterance partitions motion, sovereignty, and conflict onto an addressed pair and nonparticipation onto the speakers.

activation_trace.role: Directed departure supplies the motion assigned away from the speaking group.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the second member of the externally assigned agent pair.
Reciprocal combat is the difficult action transferred to the dual subject.
Abstention from action defines the only role the plural speakers retain.

changed_reading.before: The speakers taunt Moses and decline to fight.
changed_reading.after: The speakers redraw the agency map: Moses and his Lord own movement and conflict, while the collective claims nonparticipation as its chosen function.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: They said, we will never enter, and we are sitting repeats emphatic first-person collective assertion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech root can carry an adopted position, while repeated first-person emphasis, absolute negation, imperative redirection, and final sitting make the utterance constitutive rather than merely descriptive. The group speaks itself into a stable policy.

activation_trace.role: Speech as an adopted belief or position lets the utterance establish collective policy.
Remaining without departure gives the spoken policy the shape of permanent residence outside.
Withdrawal from action is the concrete practice created by the declaration.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a frightened reaction.
changed_reading.after: The verse records a performative counter-position by which the collective institutes refusal and inactivity as its policy.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier collective speech binds hearing to obedience inside a remembered covenant, and covenant-breaking is later imaged as undoing what was fastened. The focus repeats collective speech but replaces receptive action with emphatic non-entry and sitting, so its declaration reads as a counter-pledge.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance establishes the group's adopted position.
The confirmed bond frames the earlier first-person response as covenant performance.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the receptive half of the prior response.
Willing obedience supplies the action commitment that the focus speech reverses.
Undoing a bound structure provides the packet's explicit mechanism for covenant breach.

structural_cues: 5:7 embeds a first-person hearing-and-obedience response in remembered covenant language; 5:24 repeats first-person collective speech with non-entry and sitting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covenant, compliance, and unbinding images; I infer that the focus declaration functions as a counter-pledge. A live alternative is that it remains a situational refusal rather than a formally intended covenant act.

changed_reading.before: Their words are an immediate refusal under pressure.
changed_reading.after: Their words invert the remembered covenant response: instead of hearing that becomes action, speech now binds the group to non-action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The land is assigned and entry is commanded; the objectors make enemy exit the prerequisite of their entry; the two advisers instead make gate-entry the antecedent of victory. The focus escalates the objectors' sequence into an unlimited refusal, reversing the packet's threshold causality.

activation_trace.role: The focus blocks passage into the assigned interior.
The same threshold action appears as the initiating command.
An inscribed determination gives the destination prior authorization and obligation.
Passage outward is made by the objectors into the condition that must precede their own crossing inward.
The gate reduces an indefinite territorial problem to a concrete point of entry.
Prevailing force is presented as the result after crossing, not the prerequisite before it.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from the entry command in 5:21, through exit-before-entry in 5:22, to entry-before-victory in 5:23, and finally to unlimited non-entry in 5:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered threshold, exit, and victory clauses; I supply the causal comparison that the advisers treat crossing as enabling victory while the speakers reverse that arrow. The live alternative is ordinary tactical disagreement without a broader threshold mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The group refuses entry because the enemy still occupies the land.
changed_reading.after: The group reverses the offered strategy: it demands victory's result before crossing the threshold that the packet presents as victory's enabling act.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet acknowledges coercive opponents and expected harm, yet the two men associated with fear advocate entry and attach action to reliance and secure trust. Fear is therefore not mechanically equivalent to sitting; the focus converts a real threat into a collective policy of abdication.

activation_trace.role: Withdrawal from action is the focus response whose relation to fear is being tested.
Coercive domination preserves the reality of the threat rather than dismissing it.
Anticipation of harm remains present in the very agents who recommend movement.
Reliance supplies a way to act under danger without claiming that danger is absent.
Settled trust is made the condition for acting through the threatened threshold.

structural_cues: The two men described with the fear construction in 5:23 issue an entry imperative, whereas the plural speakers in 5:24 announce sitting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies threat, fear, reliance, and trust; I infer that it separates fear from paralysis and makes sitting a chosen response. The phrase about those who fear can alternatively refer to fear of God rather than fear of the opponents, which limits confidence but preserves the contrast.

changed_reading.before: The people sit because they are afraid of overpowering opponents.
changed_reading.after: The context allows fear and forward action to coexist, so the focus sitting is not fear's automatic consequence but the group's selected handling of fear.

context_deltas.mechanism: The group is reminded of favor and royal agency, but in the focus it transfers combat to a dual pair and sits collectively. Immediately afterward Moses can claim control only over his own self and brother and asks for separation. Endowed collective capacity contracts to an isolated dyad.

activation_trace.role: The dual combat command concentrates collective action in an assigned pair.
The plural group simultaneously withdraws itself from action.
A remembered good condition supplies the background of bestowed capacity.
Royal authority marks the group as recipients of public agency rather than passive dependents.
Possessive control narrows after the refusal to the minimal sphere Moses can still govern.
The self as one's own identity defines the first surviving unit of agency.
Brotherhood supplies the second and only other retained human bond.
Separation makes the contraction of the agentive collective explicit.

structural_cues: 5:20 addresses a favored people made kings; 5:24 opposes a dual combat verb to plural sitting; 5:25 leaves Moses naming only self and brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bestowed kingship, dual grammar, narrowed possession, and separation; I infer a contraction of political and moral agency across the sequence. A live alternative is that kingship names status or freedom without implying practical military capacity.

changed_reading.before: The group merely outsources one dangerous task to Moses.
changed_reading.after: The refusal performs collective self-divestiture: a people named as kings abandons its agency until only a separated pair remains governable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet opens by carefully regulating release from prohibition, then describes the land as assigned to the people. The focus nonetheless treats enemy presence as an unofficial bar to entry; the next ayah turns that self-authored bar into an actual imposed prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Refused crossing is the action that the speakers treat as practically unavailable.
Unlimited duration gives their practical bar the force of a self-declared prohibition.
Release from a restriction establishes the packet's controlled legal boundary vocabulary.
Binding determination marks the land as assigned before the group bars itself from it.
Explicit prevention converts the group's chosen non-entry into an externally imposed exclusion.

structural_cues: The speakers' unlimited conditional refusal in 5:24 stands between the land written for them in 5:21 and its explicit prohibition to them in 5:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies legal boundary roots before and after the focus; I infer that the emphatic conditional functions like an unauthorized self-ban that returns as a real ban. The live alternative is that the focus language is only strategic refusal, with no legal coloring.

changed_reading.before: They decline access to a place currently controlled by others.
changed_reading.after: They convert assigned access into a self-authored exclusion, which the following ayah reverses back upon them as actual prohibition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus seeks stable non-movement here for as long as the others remain there, while assigning directed movement away. The sequel fixes a forty-year term and supplies wandering without destination: refusal of purposeful motion produces compulsory motion without arrival.

activation_trace.role: Unlimited duration supplies the speakers' chosen time horizon.
Continuance fixes their refusal to the other group's continued occupancy.
Purposeful departure is assigned to Moses rather than undertaken by the speakers.
Fixed sitting names the spatial condition the speakers choose for themselves.
Prevention removes the intended destination and turns movement into exclusion.
The number four supplies the counted frame of the forty-year consequence.
Years replace the speakers' unlimited horizon with a measured but extended term.

structural_cues: The branchless wandering root at 5:26 word 7 supplies motion without arrival and is retained here only as a structural cue.
The deictic opposition between there and here in 5:24 is followed by wandering in the land in 5:26.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen sitting, delegated going, a fixed term, prohibition, and branchless wandering; I infer a spatial-temporal reversal in which rejected directed motion becomes imposed undirected motion. A live alternative is to read the sequel only as penalty, without treating its form as an inversion of the focus.

changed_reading.before: They choose to remain still and are later sentenced to wander.
changed_reading.after: Their attempted permanence reverses into motion without progress: by refusing the directed crossing, they lose both stable residence and reachable destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a second-person possessive can be ordinary direct address and does not itself deny shared lordship. It remains anchored in the focus's possessive Lord construction, favors addressed to the group, Moses's first-person Lord construction, and the ensuing separation. Downstream prose should render it only as rhetorical distancing or relational secession, never as a doctrinal denial.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speakers say your Lord when assigning combat to Moses, whereas Moses says my Lord immediately after their refusal.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign lordship is grammatically placed on the addressed side of the agency partition.
Favor addressed to the whole group keeps them inside the prior relation that their wording appears to distance.
Bestowed good upon the two active men sharpens the contrast between received relation and chosen response.
Moses reclaims the nurturing relation in first-person address after the group has pushed it toward him.
Explicit separation gives the possible rhetorical distancing a visible relational outcome.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord is simply the normal possessive used while addressing Moses.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the possessive helps push Lordship onto Moses's side, verbally seceding from a relation whose gifts had included the whole group.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the ordinary focus form denotes sitting, not a well. It remains worth carrying because the supplied sitting-root inventory includes a well abandoned before reaching water, while the context presents a gate and victory just beyond attempted entry. Render it only as a material analogy for stopping before the enabling threshold, not as lexical substitution or translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final sitting term carries a rare branch image of excavation stopped before its goal.

activation_trace.role: An unfinished well abandoned before water models cessation immediately short of a sought resource.
The gate supplies the concrete threshold at which the collective stops.
Promised prevailing force supplies the result represented as lying beyond that threshold.

changed_reading.before: Their sitting is simple inactivity before a dangerous entry.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, their sitting resembles abandoning a well just before water: they stop at the gate before testing the action linked to victory.

strongest_changes: The focus speech becomes a counter-pledge that reverses the packet's remembered hearing-and-obedience formula.
The speakers reverse threshold causality by requiring enemy exit before entry, while the advisers place entry before victory.
A favored people named as kings contracts its agency until Moses can name only himself and his brother.
Chosen sitting and unlimited refusal reverse into measured years of wandering without arrival.
summary.what_was_special: The focus tightly couples speech, duration, deictic space, and number: emphatic plural refusal immobilizes here, assigns a moving and fighting dual elsewhere, and is then answered by separation, prohibition, and wandering.
remaining_uncertainties: The referent and force of the fear construction in 5:23 leave more than one route to the fear-versus-paralysis contrast.
The possessive your Lord can support rhetorical distancing but cannot by itself establish theological disavowal.
The abandoned-well image is a packet-licensed material analogy whose distance from the ordinary sitting sense requires explicit containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Continuance is converted into permanent inaction.** `د و م B001` is stable remaining and `ق ع د B002` staying back from action. The speakers project enemy presence as endless, then answer it by fixed sitting. I infer a self-sealing temporal mechanism: imagined permanence outside produces chosen permanence inside.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Sitting becomes delegated agency.** Fixed **ق ع د / B002** (“staying back from action”) closes a speech that sends Moses and his Lord forward to fight. The preceding 5:23 joined reliance to entry; 5:25 exposes Moses’ narrowed sphere of control, and 5:26 turns the sitters’ refusal into forty years of motion without arrival. I infer that they attempt to preserve the desired outcome while outsourcing every causal step. “We are sitting here” thus reads as an active social withdrawal from responsibility, not a neutral posture.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:26 made the posture paradoxical: those who chose to sit rather than act were sentenced to prolonged movement without arrival.

يدخل فيه قولة وقوال وقوالة وتقوالة وقؤول ومقوال ومقول إذا وصفت الإنسان بأنه لسن أو كثير القول أو منطيق.
يدخل فيه المقول أو القيل بلغة أهل اليمن، والواحد القيل، والجمع المقاولة والأقيال والأقوال، وملك حمير دون الملك الأعظم، والمرأة قيلة.

يدخل فيه اقتال قولا إذا اجتر إلى نفسه قولا من خير أو شر.
يدخل فيه القالة الحسنة أو القبيحة المنتشرة في الناس، وكثرة قالة الناس، والقيل والقال بوصفهما حديثا دائرا.
يدخل فيه القال، الخشبة التي تضرب بها القلة.
يدخل فيه قاولته في أمره وتقاولنا إذا تفاوضنا.
يدخل فيه اقتال عليه إذا كان بمعنى تحكم.
يدخل فيه تقول إذا أجري مجرى تظن في العمل، وخاصة في الاستفهام، وما ذكر عن بني سليم من إجراء متصرف قلت مجرى الظن في غير الاستفهام.
يدخل فيه المتصور في النفس قبل الإبراز باللفظ، كما في قول في نفسي لم أظهره.

root_profile.summary: Kök, azlık; bir şeyin tepesi veya başı; büyük bir kap; yük taşıma, yükselme ve yola koyulma; korku ya da öfkeden titreme; nesnenin oynayıp yerinde duramaması ve hareket sesi olmak üzere altı ayrı anlam kolunda düzenlenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, temel anlamı dışarıdan içeriye geçiş olarak kuruyor; yerin yanı sıra zaman ve işe girmeyi, ayrıca bir şeyi içeri sokmayı ve aşamalı biçimde içine ilerlemeyi de bu çekirdeğe bağlıyor.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın içeri girme çekirdeğini, bir başkasını içeri sokan ettirgen kullanımdan ve özel türemiş kullanımlardan açıkça ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi ya da şey bir yerin, zamanın veya işin dışından içine geçer. Aynı çekirdek, bir başkasını içeri sokma ve bir şeyin içine aşamalı biçimde ilerleme yönleriyle genişler.

Geçiş yer, zaman veya iş alanında gerçekleşebilir ve kimi kullanımda azar azar ilerleyen bir süreç olarak sunulur.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قولهم دخل بامرأته كناية عن الإفضاء إليها.
يدخل فيه باطن الأمر والسريرة والدخلة والداخلة، وطرف الإزار الذي يلي الجسد، وما يطلع عليه من مكتوم الأمر.
يدخل فيه الدخل بمعنى العيب والفساد والدغل والريبة والمكر والخديعة والعداوة المستبطنة، وما وصف بمدخول لخلل في العقل أو الأصل أو الجوف أو الطعام.
يدخل فيه الدخيل والدخلل ومن يداخل الشخص في أموره، والقوم المنتسبون في غيرهم، والمتدخل المتكلف في الأمور.
يدخل فيه الدخل بمعنى مقابل الخرج، وما يدخل ضيعة الإنسان من المنالة.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الدخال في الورد: أن ترد الإبل إلى الحوض ثانية أو يدخل بعير عطشان بين بعيرين ليتم شربه، وكذلك إيرادها عراكا في وجه آخر.
يدخل فيه مداخلة المفاصل، واللحمة المجتمعة على عصب، والدخلة في اللون، وريش ما بين الظهر والبطن، والكلأ الداخل في أصول الشجر.
يدخل فيه الدخل اسم الطائر الصغير، وجمعه دخاخيل أو دخاليل، مع تعليل دخوله بين الأشجار الملتفة.
يدخل فيه الدوخلة: سفيفة أو منسوج من خوص يجعل فيه الرطب.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin kıpırdamadan ya da değişmeden yerinde kalması ve bu kalışın zaman içinde sürmesidir. Aynı çekirdek, bir işi bırakmadan yürütmeye, bir eylemin sürdüğü süreyi bildirmeye ve kesilmeden yağan yağmura uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin kıpırdamadan, değişmeden veya yerinden ayrılmadan kalması dalın temelidir.
Yerinde kalma düşüncesi, bir durumun zaman boyunca kesilmeden sürmesine uzanır.
Bir işe bağlı kalıp onu düzenli biçimde bırakmadan yürütmek, sürme çekirdeğinin insan eylemine uygulanmasıdır.
Bir eylemin sürdüğü süreyi bildiren yapı, zaman içindeki kesintisizliği dilbilgisel bir çerçevede belirtir.
Bir gün ve gece ya da günler boyunca kesilmeden yağan yağmur, sürekliliğin adlaşmış bir örneğidir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم
يدخل فيه الربيب والربيبة للولد المربوب من زوج سابق، والراب والرابة لمن يقوم على أمره، والحاضنة
يدخل فيه الرُّبّ الطلاء الخاثر أو ثفل السمن والزيت، والسقاء والنحي والأديم والدواء والطعام إذا جعل فيه الرُّبّ أو أصلح به
يدخل فيه رب أو أرب بالمكان إذا أقام، ومرب الإبل ومرابها، وأربت السحابة أو الجنوب إذا دامت، والإرباب بمعنى الدنو
يدخل فيه الرباب والربابة للسحاب، والسحاب المتعلق أو المركب بعضه على بعض، وما سمي بذلك لتربية النبات أو دوام المطر
يدخل فيه الشاة الرُّبّى والرباب لقرب العهد بالولادة أو لزوم البيت للبن، وربان الشيء بمعنى حدثانه وطراءته، وربى الشباب
يدخل فيه الربابة للجلدة أو الوعاء الذي تجمع فيه القداح أو سهام الميسر، وجماعة السهام نفسها
يدخل فيه الربابة والرباب للعهد والميثاق والجوار، والأربة للمعاهدين، والرباب للعشور إذا جعل كالعهد
يدخل فيه الربة والربب لضرب من الشجر أو النبت أو البقلة التي تبقى خضراء
يدخل فيه الربب للماء الكثير، ويقال للعذب، من جهة اجتماع الماء
يدخل فيه الربرب لقطيع بقر الوحش، وقيل لجماعة البقر أو الإبل
يدخل فيه رب وربما وربت وربه كحرف خافض أو حرف معنى للتقليل، ودخول ما أو التاء أو الهاء عليه
يدخل فيه الربى بمعنى الحاجة، والرابة، والعقدة المحكمة، والنعمة والإحسان

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه ربا الشيء إذا زاد أو ارتفع، وربت الأرض إذا انتفخت وزادت، والرابي الزائد أو العالي، وأربى عليه إذا أشرف أو زاد عليه.
يدخل فيه الربوة والرابية والرباوة والرباة وما ارتفع من الأرض، مع اختلاف لغات الكلمة.
يدخل فيه الربا في البيع أو القرض، والزيادة على رأس المال، والربية لغة أو اسم خاص للربا.
يدخل فيه الربو بمعنى النفس العالي أو البهر أو الانبهار، وما يصيب الإنسان أو الدابة من علو النفس أو الانتفاخ من مشي أو عدو أو فزع.
يدخل فيه ربيت الولد أو تربيته بمعنى غذوته، وربا الولد أو الزرع بالنماء، وربوت أو ربيت في القوم بمعنى نشأت فيهم.
يدخل فيه الأربية أو الأربيتان بمعنى أصل الفخذ أو لحمتين ناتئتين في أصول الفخذين من باطن.
يدخل فيه قولهم جاء في أربية قومه أي في أهل بيته من بني الأعمام ونحوهم.

root_profile.summary: Kökün dalları yaşamı sona erdirme çekirdeği çevresinde öldürülmeye açık bırakma, karşılıklı savaşma ve ölümü göze alma yönlerine yayılır; ayrıca boyun eğdirme, kesin bilme, nazlanma, içkiyi yumuşatma, düşman veya denk kişi, can ve sağlam beden, beddua ile kışın insanları koruyan kişi gibi kalıba bağlı uzak anlamlar taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, ayakta durmanın karşıtı olan oturmayı, tek oturuşu, oturuş biçimini ve oturulan yeri birlikte verir. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği doğru yakalar; işten geri durma, pusu ve yapı temeli gibi başka dallar bu tanımın dışında tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak oturma çekirdeği korunur; yer, tek oturuş, oturuş biçimi ve kalıba bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir canlının ayakta durmayı bırakıp bir yerde oturması veya orada yer tutmasıdır; bundan tek oturuş, oturuş biçimi ve oturulan yer adları doğar.

facets.statement: Ana çekirdek, ayakta durmanın karşıtı olan bedensel oturmadır.
Tek bir oturma olayı ve oturan kişinin aldığı biçim ayrıca adlandırılır.
Oturma eyleminden, insanların oturduğu yer veya koltuk anlamı gelişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ortak biçimde oturmayı ayakta durmanın karşıtı olarak verir; aynı aktarım içinde tek oturuş, oturuş biçimi ve oturulan yer de bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bedensel oturma çekirdeğini ve bundan doğan oturulan yer anlamını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Oturma, ayakta durmaya karşıtlık ve yer tutma ilişkisi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Tek bir oturma olayı veya oturan kişinin biçimi vurgulandığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Oturma olayını ve biçimini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal tek oturuş, oturuş biçimi ve oturulan yer adlarını aynı çekirdekte açıkça tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal oturma olayını meclis, birlikte oturma ve eşlik alanına daha geniş taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedensel oturma ve bir yerde bulunma alanını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sınırı, ayakta durmanın karşıtı olan oturma ve bundan doğan biçim veya yer adlarıdır; komşu dal ise sosyal beraberlik ve meclis anlamlarını daha görünür kılar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşuların tümü oturma, durma, yer ve türemiş özel alanlar bakımından denetlendi; yalnız sınırı belirginleştiren yakın komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الجلوس خلاف القيام؛ والمرة والهيئة من القعود؛ وموضع القعود والمقعد
branches.source_phrase_ar: قعد الرجل يقعد قعودا (maqayis;ayn;tahdhib)؛ قعد قعودا أي جلس (sihah)؛ القعود يقابل به القيام (mufradat)؛ القعدة المرة الواحدة (maqayis;ayn;sihah;mufradat)؛ المقاعد موضع قعود الناس (maqayis;sihah)؛ المقعد مكان القعود (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, savaşa veya çıkışa katılmama, işte tembellik, bir engel yüzünden alıkonma ve duraklama anlamlarını aynı geri durma ekseninde toplar. Bu, duyusal oturmadan ayrıdır ve geçici çerçeve bu ayrımı doğru verir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak ve türemiş kullanımlar birlikte görünür; tanım duyusal oturmayı değil eylemden geri durmayı esas alır.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin çıkması, savaşması, işe koyulması ya da cömertçe davranması beklenen yerde geri durması, alıkonması veya duraklamasıdır.

facets.statement: Ana anlam, beklenen bir eylemden veya çıkıştan geri durmaktır.
Geri durma, tembellik veya iç isteksizlik olarak anlatılabilir.
Aynı alan, bir işten alıkoyan dış engel veya meşguliyeti de kapsar.
Sefere veya resmi kayda katılmayan topluluk bu geri durma alanının özel bir örneğidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak aktarım, eylem beklenen yerde geri kalma, tembellik, durma ve bir sebep tarafından alıkonma biçimlerini aynı işlevsel alanda toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Savaşa, çıkışa, işe veya beklenen davranışa katılmama çekirdeğini en kısa biçimde karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Beklenen eylemden kalma, isteksizlik ve duraklama ilişkisi korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geri durmanın kişinin dışındaki bir meşguliyet veya engel yüzünden gerçekleştiği bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleme geçememe ve engellenme ilişkisini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendi isteksizliği veya tembelliğiyle geri durmasını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sefere veya işe katılmayıp geri duran kimse
sefere kayıtlı olmayan ya da savaştan geri kalan topluluk
görüşünü taşıdığı halde ayaklanmaya katılmayan kişi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Geri durma burada bir eyleme katılmama veya alıkonma sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bedensel oturma ve oturulan yer çekirdeğini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da harekete geçmeme veya yerinde kalma görüntüsü bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal, beklenen fiilden kalmayı anlatır; komşu dal ise bedensel oturuşu ve ondan doğan yer adını tanımlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Eylemden kalma, yavaşlama, tembellik, engellenme ve iç kök dalları karşılaştırıldı; en yararlı sınır duyusal oturma ile ayrımda yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التخلف عن الغزو أو الخروج؛ والتكاسل؛ والحبس والعوق عن الحاجة أو السخاء؛ والتوقف
branches.source_phrase_ar: القعد القوم لا ديوان لهم (maqayis;ayn;sihah)؛ رجل قاعد عن الغزو (tahdhib)؛ يعبر عن المتكاسل في الشيء بالقاعد (mufradat)؛ ما قعدك واقتعدك أي حبسك (ayn)؛ ما تقعدني عن ذلك الأمر إلا شغل (tahdhib)؛ إنا هاهنا قاعدون يعني متوقفون (mufradat)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المرأة التي قعدت عن الحيض أو الولد أو الأزواج؛ وجمعها قواعد
يدخل فيه الجليس والمقاعد؛ والزوجة المسماة قعيدة؛ والخادم الذي يقعد الإنسان أو يخدمه
يدخل فيه القعيد الرقيب؛ والقعود للشيء ترصدا؛ وما يأتي من خلف من وحش أو طائر
يدخل فيه قعيدك الله وقعدك الله وقعدك في معنى القسم أو المناشدة
يدخل فيه أساس البيت؛ وقواعد الهودج؛ وأسافل السحاب؛ وما ارتكن من الرمل بعضه فوق بعض
يدخل فيه الدابة أو البعير الذي يقتعد للركوب؛ والقعدة والقعود والقعودة؛ وما يلحق بذلك من السروج والرحال
يدخل فيه المقعد الذي لا يطيق المشي؛ والزمانة؛ وداء الإبل في الأوراك؛ وتقوس رجل الفرس حتى لا تنتصب
يدخل فيه فراخ الطير قبل النهوض؛ وفرخ النسر؛ والجراد الذي لم يستو جناحه؛ والضفادع المشبهة بالقعود؛ والنخل الصغار والفسيلة إذا صار لها جذع
يدخل فيه الثدي المقعد الناهد؛ والغرارة أو الجوالق الممتلئ؛ والرمل غير المستطيل؛ والرحى القاعدة
يدخل فيه القعدد وأقعد النسب إذا قل الوسائط إلى الجد الأكبر أو كان أقرب إلى الأب الأكبر
يدخل فيه القعدد اللئيم أو الجبان؛ ومقعد الحسب؛ وما أقعد عن السخاء أو المكارم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak deyimi, kazılmış fakat suya ulaşılamadan bırakılmış kuyu anlamını açıkça verir. Bu, yürüyemeyen kişi veya bedensel oturma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kuyuya bağlı özel kullanımdır; hastalık veya oturma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Kazılmasına başlanıp suya ulaşılamadan bırakılan kuyudur.

facets.statement: Ana anlam, kazılmış fakat suya erişmeden bırakılmış kuyudur.
Kuyunun terk edilme nedeni, kazının suya ulaşmamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Aktarım, kuyu kazısının suya ulaşmadan bırakılmasını ortak biçimde verir; belirleyici unsur kazılmış olma ve sonuçsuz bırakılmadır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Kazı, suya erişememe ve terk edilme aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu, kazılmış olma, suya ulaşmama ve bırakılma korunur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kuyunun sonuçsuz bırakılması öne çıktığında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kuyu ve bırakılma fikrini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal suya ulaşılamadığı için bırakılmış kuyu kazısıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kuyu türünü, derinliğini veya taşla örülmemiş olmasını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kuyu ve kazılmış çukur alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal bir kazı sürecinin başarısız ve terk edilmiş sonucudur; komşu dal kuyu nesnesinin tür veya biçim adıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Kuyu, kazma, su çıkarma, suyun gitmesi ve iç kök adayları denetlendi; süreç sonucu ayrımını veren komşu yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه البئر التي حفرت ثم تركت قبل أن تنتهي إلى الماء
branches.source_phrase_ar: المقعدة من الآبار التي أقعدت فلم ينته بها إلى الماء وتركت (maqayis)؛ المقعدة من الآبار التي أقعدت فلم ينته بها إلى الماء فتركت (ayn)؛ المقعدة من الآبار التي احتفرت فلم ينبط ماؤها فتركت (tahdhib)

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استعمال قعد مع الفعل بمعنى طفق أو صار؛ وأقعد بالمكان بمعنى أقام
يدخل فيه البيت الذي فيه زحاف إذا سمي مقعدا؛ والإقواء الذي سماه بعضهم المقعد

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, oturma ve bir yerde durma çekirdeğinden hareketle geri durma, bağlı bulunma, gözetleme, temel oluşturma, binek, güçsüzlük, gelişme evresi, soy mesafesi ve terimleşmiş takvim veya şiir kullanımlarına açılır. Dalların çoğu konum, duruş, dayanak ya da eylemden kalma ilişkisini korur.
